edition: Corporation Tax Statistics 2026, published 24 September 2026 (cover sheet: all tables updated in September 2026; next release autumn 2027)
tables: Table 6A: Tax liability by SIC section
Table 6B: Number of companies by SIC section with > £0 CT payable
method: Every figure was read from the downloaded workbook on the access date by tools/extract_uk_firm_ct_tables.py; none was filled from memory. Counts are as published (rounded by HMRC to the nearest 5) and amounts are GBP million as published (rounded to the nearest million). HMRC section U is 'Overseas; Unclassified, Dormant and Non-trading', not SIC section U alone. This table is held out of the profit draw and used only to check it.
liability_concept: The tables' 'tax liability' total equals 'Corporation Tax payable' in Table 5A of the same workbook: after double taxation relief and other charges and reliefs, including ring fence Corporation Tax and the supplementary charge.
